meta.title: Voice Mode
meta.description: Full-duplex voice conversation for DeepSeek Harness: local streaming speech recognition (no API key) fills an editable draft, replies are read aloud sentence by sentence with live captions, and speaking interrupts the reply.

en.aecOffHint: Native echo cancellation is not active (speaker echo may self-interrupt); use headphones or Manual barge-in
en.barHold: Voice mode xB7 hold to talk (tap to exit)
en.botLevelsHint: AI playback level (blue bar = TTS playback, green bar = microphone)
en.configUnavailableNote: (settings document not ready; retrying — the panel will appear when it is).
en.dataFlowHint: Data flow: ASR recognition (zipformer2+SenseVoice) is always local; TTS playback depends on engine (edge=Microsoft cloud, vits/kokoro=local)
en.descAutoSend: Auto-send once quiet (consecutive segments join into one message; off = draft only; holding Ctrl while speaking sends immediately; in hold mode, releasing sends)
en.descBackchannelYield: When the user says a short answer like "mm-hmm/right" while the agent is reading aloud, yield automatically (skip the current TTS sentence + drop frames for 1.5s; if the user really wants to speak, the existing hardBreak takes over; off = no yielding, behavior matches before this change). Only triggers in hold-to-talk mode: in continuous-listening mode speech is not recognized during playback (speaking is treated as an interrupt)
en.descBargeIn: Barge-in mode (detect: auto-probe native echo cancellation, fall back to hold-to-talk when inactive — default; auto: force interrupt by speaking — headphones/quiet; manual: for loudspeaker, no echo-triggered self-interrupt — hold mic/Ctrl to interrupt). Note: in manual mode (including detect falling back to manual on machines without native echo cancellation) audio outside a press is not recognized — in toggle mode you can long-press to speak only while the agent is playing; when idle there is no voice input, so use hold mode or switch to auto/detect
en.descCaptionFontSize: Caption font size (Small 12 / Standard 14 / Large 18 / X-Large 24 px; default Small matches current behavior)
en.descCaptionMaxWidth: Caption width (50vw / 70vw / 90vw; default 70vw; capped at 30vh height so multi-line 24px never overlaps the input box)
en.descComposerShortcut: Shortcut to toggle voice mode while the composer has focus (default Alt/Option+Enter)
en.descEchoGate: Echo gate threshold (dB, default 6): auto barge-in requires the residual to exceed the echo floor by this value. With the native browser AEC active, this gate is idle; it kicks in as a fallback in Safari or environments without native AEC (e.g. some headphones). Raise (8-10) if speaker echo still interrupts, lower (3-4) if hard to interrupt
en.descIdle: Auto-exit voice mode after idle minutes (default 5; a 30-second countdown warning appears before exit)
en.descInterrupt: Interrupt sensitivity (0 high ≈0.3 s confirm / 1 medium ≈0.2 s / 2 low ≈0.1 s, most responsive); lower = higher barrier = harder to interrupt
en.descKokoroModel: Kokoro model precision: int8 is smaller/faster (CPU server or low bandwidth; default); fp32 sounds better but ~311MB and slower (GPU or large memory). Both share the same 103 voices; switches live.
en.descLlmCorrect: Before sending, run one LLM pass over the whole transcribed text (typos/homophones/punctuation only, meaning preserved; requires a default model configured in the host — otherwise the original text is sent as-is). On = one extra correction round trip per message: usually under 1 second, at most ~10 seconds; at most 10 times per minute — when voice mode is off or the limit is hit, the original text is sent. Failed or abnormal output also falls back to the original text
en.descMode: Interaction mode (toggle: continuous listen + auto-send / hold: press to talk / once: one utterance, then exit after the reply is read aloud)
en.descModelHost: ASR model download source (official source / mirror, or any custom URL)
en.descRate: Speech rate (0.5 slow – 2.0 fast, 1.1 default; more compact replies)
en.descReadAloud: Voice mode = read replies only in voice mode (default); Always = read every reply in the current session, typed ones included; Off = never read aloud
en.descSenseITN: SenseVoice number/date/format normalization (default on; turn off to keep raw spoken form)
en.descSenseVoice: Recognition mode: on = accurate mode (SenseVoice finalization with punctuation + ITN; long utterances may take seconds on CPU); off = fast mode (streaming result finalized directly, skips the 228 MB re-transcription model, slightly less accurate)
en.descShortcut: Shortcut to enter/exit voice mode (e.g. Ctrl+Shift+V; empty disables it, mic button only; avoid browser-reserved combos like Ctrl+W/N/T)
en.descShowCaptions: Show a floating caption of the current sentence while reading aloud
en.descShowStatusBar: Show the voice status bar above the composer (waveform, transcript, timer, notices, exit); when off, state shows only on the mic button
en.descSilence: Silence pause before a sentence is committed (default 1500 ms; at least 250 ms of speech required, guards against noise triggers)
en.descSpokenFormat: Inject spoken-format prompt into voice replies (colloquial, short sentences, no Markdown; default on, live)
en.descToolBeep: Tool-call beep (default off): beep when the agent is thinking/calling tools; keep off if it annoys you
en.descTtsEngine: Local VITS (Chinese only) / Local Kokoro (Chinese + English) / Edge cloud (most natural, text sent to Microsoft)
en.descVoice: Edge cloud voices (auto-loads all Microsoft voices; common Chinese voices pinned on top; ◀▶ or dropdown; custom ShortName allowed)
en.descVoiceKokoro: Kokoro zh-en voices (103; ◀▶ to cycle; 48-51 named Chinese, others numbered with measured gender; mixed zh-en supported)
en.descVoiceLocal: Local voice (vits, all 5 speakers listed; dropdown or ◀▶; no custom needed)
en.descWakeWord: Wake word (default off; e.g. "Hey D"): recognition starts only after you say it, to avoid accidental triggers. You may say it together with your command ("Hey D, check the weather" — the wake word is stripped and never sent); it must be repeated after each utterance split or barge-in; toggle mode only (inactive in hold / manual barge-in — and equally inactive when the detect probe fails and falls back to manual, the default on machines without native echo cancellation such as Safari); saying it while the agent is reading does not trigger (barge-in stays VAD-based). Fault-tolerant matching (homophones / leading fillers); 3-4 characters recommended; not a dedicated KWS engine — noisy environments may delay or falsely trigger
en.descYieldMs: How long (ms) to drop frames after a yield trigger (500-3000, default 1500; within the window the existing hardBreak takes over if the user really wants to speak; auto-resume after the window expires). Hold-to-talk mode only, during playback
en.detectFail: Break-in detection temporarily unavailable (detect channel error, retrying)
en.effectivePending: {count} change(s) will apply next time you enter voice mode: {items}
en.errEngineNotActive: That read-aloud engine is not active
en.errForbidden: Request denied (local access only, or origin mismatch)
en.errKokoroNeedsNode: Local Kokoro cannot run directly inside the official desktop app (Electron): install Node.js >= 18 on PATH (or set DSHVM_NODE to its path), or switch the read-aloud engine to Edge / local VITS.
en.errModelDownload: Model download failed — check your network
en.errRateLimited: Too many requests — try again shortly
en.errTooManyStreams: Too many voice connections — close other voice tabs and retry
en.errUnknownSession: Voice session expired — re-enter voice mode
en.idleTimeoutQuit: Idle timeout — voice mode auto-exited (adjustable in settings)
en.micBusy: Microphone is in use by another program — close it and retry
en.micDenied: Microphone denied: allow mic access for this site
en.modelDownloadFail: Model download failed ({file}): check network and re-enter voice mode
en.modelsHint: Live download state; failures auto-backoff 60s. After switching the mirror, click Retry to take effect immediately; npm run prefetch pre-downloads.
en.modelsRetryHint: Click to retry now after switching mirror or a failure
en.partialFail: Live captions temporarily unavailable (recognition channel error, retrying)
en.previewCheck: Preview failed: check network or ShortName
en.previewDisabled: Voice mode disabled (plugin enabled=false); preview unavailable
en.previewEngine: Preview failed: engine not ready (local model downloading, init failed, or worker crashed) — retry later or check TTS status in settings
en.previewModelLoading: Local model is downloading — please wait
en.previewNetwork: Preview failed: network unreachable (Edge cloud needs the Microsoft speech service) — check your network or proxy
en.previewPlayFail: Preview failed: cannot play this voice
en.previewRateLimited: Preview too frequent — wait a few seconds (20/min limit)
en.previewText: Preview failed: the engine produced empty audio (voice and language may not match) — pick another voice
en.previewTimeout: Synthesis timed out: model still loading, retry in a few seconds
en.sendFailKept: Send failed; text kept in draft
en.sessionExpiredFail: Voice session reconnect failed; please re-enter voice mode
en.settingsCardDesc: Engine / voice / rate / interrupt / barge-in / echo gate / silence / idle / model host / auto-send / read replies / status bar / caption overlay / auto-resume / mode / wake word / tool beep / ITN / caption font / caption width / yielding / yield window / barge-in salvage / LLM correction
en.settingsEffectiveNote: When settings apply, in four tiers: ① immediately — engine / voice / rate / Kokoro model precision (immediate when cached, else next download) / spoken format (applies to later replies) / read replies / status bar / caption overlay / model mirror (next download attempt); ② next recognition — finalization re-transcription (SenseVoice) / ITN; ③ next utterance — silence threshold (endpoint; the send wait stays a fixed 1.2s); ④ next time you enter voice mode — interrupt sensitivity / barge-in mode / echo gate / shortcut / auto-send / auto-resume / interaction mode / wake word / tool beep / caption font / caption width / backchannel yielding / yield window / barge-in salvage / LLM correction / idle timeout. Items that take effect next time you enter voice mode are listed at the top of this card with their current effective values.
en.shortcutInvalid: Invalid shortcut, disabled. Fix it in settings (e.g. Ctrl+Shift+V); leave empty to use the mic button only
en.shortcutNeedModifier: At least one modifier is required
en.shortcutNote: Alt/Option+Enter toggles inside the composer; Cmd / Ctrl / Alt / Shift combos are supported; leaving it empty means mic button only. While recording, Backspace clears and Esc cancels; avoid browser-reserved combos (Cmd+W / T / N / L). Changes apply immediately.
en.shortcutPlaceholder: Click Record, then press a combo
en.shortcutUnsupportedKey: Only letters, digits, Enter, Space and Tab are supported
en.titleHold: Voice mode xB7 hold to talk, release to send; tap to exit; Esc/blur cancels; Ctrl+Shift+V exits
en.titleToggle: Voice mode xB7 click to exit (Ctrl+Shift+V) xB7 hold Ctrl while speaking to send now
en.ttsDeleteHint: Delete local models (frees space; auto re-downloads on next use)
en.ttsDownloadHint: Download this engine's local model; becomes ready immediately after
en.ttsSkipNotice: One sentence failed to read and was skipped (resend the message to retry)
en.ttsUnavailableNotice: Read-aloud keeps failing: cloud TTS is unavailable. Try again later, or switch the read-aloud engine to local VITS / Kokoro in settings
en.voiceHintChineseVoice: Note: this is a Chinese voice. For English replies, pick an English voice (en-…) from the list.
en.voiceHintEnglishVoice: Note: this is an English voice and reads Chinese replies poorly. For Chinese conversations, pick a Chinese voice (zh-…).
